title: Hindu outfit members protest and clash with police in Madurai
seoTitle: Madurai protest over Karthigai Deepam lamp

tea.why: Protesters demonstrated because authorities lit the Karthigai Deepam lamp at the usual spot instead of the disputed hilltop stone pillar.
tea.want: Demonstrators demanded that authorities implement the Supreme Court's directive to light the ceremonial lamp at the Deepathoon pillar.
tea.changed: Nov 24: Police detained numerous demonstrators and cleared the hill pathway following scuffles in Madurai.

summary: On November 24, 2026, members of Hindu organisations, the BJP, and Hindu Munnani staged protests and clashed with police in Madurai, Tamil Nadu. The demonstrations erupted after authorities lit the annual Karthigai Deepam ceremonial lamp at the traditional Uchipillayar Temple spot rather than at the 'Deepathoon' stone pillar, despite a Supreme Court interim order designating the pillar for a one-time lighting. Gathered devotees and political functionaries chanted slogans, blocked pathways, and resisted police interventions, leading to physical scuffles. Police deployed heavy security and forcefully detained numerous protesters and leaders. The Madras High Court's Madurai Bench later directed authorities to comply with the Supreme Court's order and release detained individuals.
demands: Light the Karthigai Deepam at the Deepathoon stone pillar
Comply with the Supreme Court directive as a one-time measure
response: Police deployed heavy security, warned protesters of lathi charges, and detained numerous demonstrators following scuffles. According to a senior advocate, 258 people were detained in connection with prohibitory orders.

updates.text: Protests and scuffles broke out in Thirupparankundram after the lamp was lit at the traditional location instead of the Deepathoon pillar.
